name: @harukoia/motor-colaborativo
description: Motor colaborativo HaruKoia — pizarra en tiempo real, publicación a markdown y réplica al repositorio

scripts.dev: node scripts/open-design-dev.mjs start && node scripts/pm2-root-dev.mjs start && node scripts/pm2-root-dev.mjs logs
scripts.dev:start: node scripts/open-design-dev.mjs start && node scripts/pm2-root-dev.mjs start
scripts.dev:stop: node scripts/pm2-root-dev.mjs stop; node scripts/open-design-dev.mjs stop
scripts.dev:restart: node scripts/open-design-dev.mjs restart && node scripts/pm2-root-dev.mjs restart
scripts.dev:status: node scripts/pm2-root-dev.mjs status && node scripts/open-design-dev.mjs status
